messages.subject: dataProcessPlots not plotting
parts:
Hello, I am new to msstats, and am having some trouble generating data process plots on my own data and the package data. For example, the following code taken from the manual doesn't generate any plots.

>QuantData<-dataProcess(SRMRawData, use_log_file = FALSE)
>dataProcessPlots(data=QuantData,type="ProfilePlot")

I have tried updating R/Rstudio, reinstalling everything to the most recent version (4.10.0), and no plots are generated. When I back up further and plot(cars), I do generate a plot, however.

Any help, or things I can further try to troubleshoot this would be appreciated! Thanks!

Additional info below.

R version 4.3.2 (2023-10-31)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin20 (64-bit)
Running under: macOS Sonoma 14.2.1

other attached packages:
[1] dplyr_1.1.4         MSstats_4.10.0      BiocManager_1.30.22

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: dataProcessPlots not plotting
parts:
Hi Lindsay,

By default the MSstats ` dataProcessPlots` function creates a PDF of the plots in your working directory. You should be able to find this file after running the code you provided.

If you want the plots to show up in your Rstudio, you can set the `address` parameter to FALSE. On a side note, if you want to produce the plots in Rstudio I would recommend only plotting a couple proteins at a time because generating 1000 plots would be alot to go through. You can plot individual (or a list of) proteins by setting the `which.Protein` parameter. 

```
dataProcessPlots(data=QuantData,
                                  type="ProfilePlot",
                                  which.Protein=0, # This can be an index (numeric) or a string of the protein name
                                  address=FALSE)
```

Devon
